text:
maya: Dropping a quick design review for the new Throughput Waterfall prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/throughput-waterfall (page: 'keyboard + annotations'). Looking for UX + a11y reactions.

sam: skimmed it. Love the runtime breakdown. Two things: keyboard focus for bars, and how annotations are surfaced.

jon: Yup. Bars need to be focusable. Proposed interactions: Tab to bar, Enter expands details, Space pins an annotation. Also Arrow keys to move between adjacent bars when expanded.

lee: Accessibility note: screen reader label should be concise but informative, e.g. "Throughput segment: encoder, median 45ms, p95 120ms". Keep it short so NVDA doesn't read a wall of text.

maya: I added a draft SR string in the figma: 
```
Throughput segment: component={name}. median={med}ms. p95={p95}ms. press Enter for traces and annotations.
```
Open to trimming words.

aisha: Color nits: current purple/green combo fails for some deuteranopes. Suggest a blue/orange pair (ColorBrewer) and add hatching for any offline/unknown bars.

sam: Hatching is good. Also the tooltip is too verbose; show only the top 3 items (name, p95, link to traces). Defer everything else to the expanded panel.

jon: Annotations UX: users want to attach saved runs and alert snapshots. Idea: tiny chips under each bar with a timestamp and icon. Click opens a right-side details panel. Keyboard: arrow to chip, Enter to open.

maya: For pill copy, how about short canonical format: `2026-02-03 • deploy #128 — jazz-optimizer` ?

lee: Prefer `YYYY-MM-DD • deploy #` and optional short tag separated by an em-dash. Screen readers should read the full pill text.

aisha: Time-range picker copy: label currently `Last 1h` was confusing for some (rolling vs aligned). Option A: add `(rolling)` in label; Option B: show a hover hint. I prefer hover hint: `Rolling window: slides with time` to keep labels concise.

sam: Hover hint works. We'll add an info icon with that tooltip.

jon: Rendering concern: for high-cardinality queries the waterfall blows up. Add a sampling control dropdown: `Top 10 | Top 50 | All (sampled)` and show estimated sampling rate.

aisha: Suggested microcopy for picker: `Showing top N segments by throughput. Lower N reduces rendering cost.` Also show a live rendering cost estimate like `~15ms/frame` when N is high.

maya: UX flow: if user picks `All (sampled)` show a subtle banner: `Rendering sample: 25% of segments — results approximate` with a `Why?` link to a short explainer.

lee: Ensure banner color contrast meets 4.5:1 and the close button is keyboard reachable.

sam: Visual tweak: current focus dims other bars which removes context for colorblind users. Alternative: keep others visible, apply an inset border and slightly brighten the focused bar. Also add a `Reduce motion` toggle for users who prefer minimal animations.

aisha: Add `High contrast` preference that disables dimming and uses thicker borders. Map it to system preferences where possible.

maya: I'll update the figma: swap to blue/orange, add hatches, implement keyboard flows and sampling control, include pill format and banner copy. Will post a new link in ~45m.

colorbot: figma-update by maya at 1729612400. Automated a11y scan: WARN banner contrast < 4.5:1.

jon: I'll tweak banner bg and text to fix contrast.

sam: Quick copy nudge: expanded header currently says `Segment details`. Can we rename to `Throughput details` for clarity?

maya: Yep switching to `Throughput details` + adjusting SR text.

lee: One more: add per-panel `?` that opens quick keyboard help (e.g., Enter=open, Space=pin, Arrows=navigate). Keyboard users expect `?` to reveal bindings.

aisha: Add it to global shortcuts doc too.

maya: Great. Thanks everyone — super actionable. :sparkles:

sam: :thumbsup:

jon: :eyes:
